# PINNED (E5). Generated by freezing the image that is known to work.
#
# Unpinned deps here are not a style issue, they are an outage: a rebuild
# once resolved a newer SQLAlchemy that maps bare `postgresql://` onto psycopg
# v3, which this image does not ship, and the API crash-looped. The URL was
# patched to `postgresql+psycopg2://` at the time; this is the root-cause fix.
#
# To move a version: change it here, `docker compose build api`, smoke-test the
# new image on a throwaway container BEFORE `up -d`, then commit.
#
# Direct dependencies

APScheduler==3.11.3   # in-process cron (replaced n8n)
tzdata==2026.5   # America/New_York in slim containers
